title: A coordinator pick reaches the page as an item the owner can overrule
why: Owner 12:08 CST Nov 12 (coordinator relay 12:10 CST): he cannot see coordinator picks anywhere to overrule them.
note: A check that a coordinator message saying "coordinator pick" has a matching item on the page with `stands: true` (section Pick stands). Extend the home of steps c102 (an undoable pick is taken, not asked; the Stop reply judge) and c118 (a decision always reaches a clickable pick), both done, before a new home. Red first on today's case: 19 picks on Nov 12 with no page item until 12:13 CST. Shape (coordinator 12:10 CST): a check, not a note. A send_message from a cs-build:coordinator session whose text names "coordinator pick" is refused unless the same turn also sent triage the pick, or the message goes to triage. Mistake: 19 picks on Nov 12 reached no page (owner 12:08 CST); owner 12:09 CST: "this needs to be mechanized". Home to weigh first: step coordinator-pick-needs-record (doing). Lane started 12:12 CST.
